source: A computer systems and theory bibliography in IEEE style, built for this suite from records checked against Crossref and DataCite on 2026-10-03; errors planted by hand. Invented DOIs checked unregistered at doi.org, and closed_real papers checked closed in OpenAlex, the same day.
